content.incidence: Approximately 2–8 per 100,000 maternities (text shows corrupted characters but approximates this range).
case_fatality_rates: Retrospective Californian study (>3.5 million deliveries) reported case fatality of 13%.
Prospective UK population-based study with validated case criteria reported case fatality of 19%.
content.management: Supportive care based on high-quality emergency care following recognition and diagnosis; prompt treatment of bleeding and coagulopathy.
content.education_note: Awareness of AFE should be integral to education of involved physicians and to emergency algorithms.
